description: Living topic index for AI assistant chats: classifies conversation turns into topics across chats, renders a topic map, and produces resumable per-topic digests so you can find any thread and continue it with full context. Tools: topic_map, list_topics, apply_classified_turns, topic_digest. The agent does the classifying (keyless, dependency-light); the server does the bookkeeping.
name: io.github.imdonothing-ui/chat-topic-bucketer

environment_variables.description: Path to the topics.json index (defaults to ~/chat-topics/topics.json)
environment_variables.name: BUCKETER_INDEX

title: Chat Topic Bucketer
